text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: DICE is an open-source arcade emulator focused on preserving early arcade games and experimental hardware. Unlike general-purpose arcade emulators, it recreates individual arcade systems at a lower hardware level, allowing historically important machines to be studied and preserved. The project supports a limited selection of classic arcade titles and focuses on accuracy, documentation, and preservation of early video game technology.
